LivePulse.title: LivePulse
LivePulse.description: Non-PII real-time synchronization pulse emitted by the SportX backend whenever Cloud SQL state changes (bookings, court blocks, roster/ban updates, gate check-ins, light alerts, or policy changes).

channelId.description: Channel identifier matching the document ID (e.g., global).

version.description: Monotonically increasing sequence counter for client delta detection.

lastEventType.description: Type of mutation event that triggered the sync pulse.

affectedDate.description: Sports-day YYYY-MM-DD affected by the mutation, if applicable.

sportId.description: Sport identifier affected by the mutation, if applicable.

updatedAt.description: ISO-8601 server timestamp of the last Cloud SQL commit.

/live_sync/{channelId}.description: Read-only client listener channel updated exclusively by the SportX Express backend via firebase-admin after Cloud SQL transactions.
